test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: SUZD is related to ZBGK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, UWBF is related to BDIM. To which of the following options is PRWA related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Pair 1: SUZD : ZBGK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4dde9386a8a1ad6acfa2c25f23a7a397973b572ad4a0db3e9f542d2081b1185.png] 

**Pair 2: UWBF : BDIM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47ebc7c71012271edb56f2b85e88f31498dae08c243895de9f7a21b5c37d4c84.png] 

**Applying the logic to PRWA:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc2cfdb8182e51626aa6ae36417755093b328f74d22b886c1807c29203b1d5fa.png] 

Thus, PRWA is related to **WYDH**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2"**.
